Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
BernieTime wrote:
> If Smudge were to have is capacity reduced by X so that his capacity is now (0)
> Zero, what happens? Is Smudge now caught in an infinite hunting loop?

* A vampire's capacity can never be reduced below one, even by the effects of
Violet Tremain or Mind of a Child. [RTR 12-JUL-1999]

Messages.Author: Flux
Messages.Body:
BernieTime <berni...@aol.com> wrote in message
news:20011022130921...@mb-bj.aol.com...

> If Smudge were to have is capacity reduced by X so that his capacity is
now (0)
> Zero, what happens? Is Smudge now caught in an infinite hunting loop?
>
> While this may or may not be currently possible, was just wondering.

Yes, an empty vampire must hunt, and if his capacity is 0 he'll stay empty
and have to hunt again the following turn.
This is no longer possible, but it used to be: before the SW reprint of
Violet Tremain, her ability allowed her to reduce a vampire's capacity to 0.

Flux
